data.name: About_Title
data.value: A tutor that teaches, not one that does your homework

data.name: About_Subtitle
data.value: TutorForge follows the Socratic method: it asks questions and gives hints so the student finds the answer by themselves. Choose the mode that fits what you need.

data.name: About_Mode_Guide
data.value: One question or hint at a time. The final answer only comes after real attempts.

data.name: About_Mode_Explain
data.value: A simple definition, an everyday example, a worked example and a question to check understanding.

data.name: About_Mode_Check
data.value: Says if the answer is right, points to the step with the mistake and gives a hint to fix it.

data.name: About_Mode_Practice
data.value: One exercise at a time, harder when you succeed, easier when you struggle.

data.name: About_Privacy_Text
data.value: No account, no database: the conversation stays in the browser page and is sent only to answer. The tutor never asks for personal information.

data.name: About_Safety_Text
data.value: Age-appropriate answers, kind refusal of off-limits topics, and if a student seems unwell, the tutor encourages them to talk to a trusted adult.

data.name: About_Tech_Text
data.value: ASP.NET Core (.NET 10), Claude API with streaming, Tailwind CSS + Preline UI, Markdown and math (KaTeX) rendering. Offline demo mode without an API key.
